fullPassage: The sit-in movement was part of the struggle for racial equality in the US. Its goal was to end the forced separation of races in public places. One of the most important events of this movement was the moment when some African American college students sat in a segregated section of a restaurant in North Carolina. They were told to leave, but they protested by remaining in their seats. This was not the first sit-in of the civil rights movement, but it led to a series of similar protests. During them, protesters occupied seats in places where races were segregated, including restaurants and libraries. They refused to move unless they were either served or arrested. Many establishments decided to end their practice of racial segregation rather than deal with more protests. These sit-ins helped pass the Civil Rights Act of 1964, which officially ended segregation in public places.

① 일치 — 'including restaurants and libraries(식당과 도서관 포함)'와 맞아요.

② 일치 — 'decided to end their practice of racial segregation(분리 관행을 없애기로 결정)'과 맞아요.

③ 불일치 — 본문은 'This was not the first sit-in(이것은 최초의 연좌 농성이 아니었다)'이라고 했어요. '최초의 시위'라는 진술은 사실과 달라 이것이 정답이에요 ←정답

④ 일치 — 'These sit-ins helped pass the Civil Rights Act of 1964(민권법 통과를 도왔다)'와 맞아요.
det.tip: not the first sit-in → '최초'는 틀림(불일치)

이 연좌 농성은 이전에 선례가 없던 최초의 시위였다.

questions.passage: ①Refuse to leave their seats, the students continued their peaceful protest against segregation. The restaurant staff repeatedly ②told them to go, but the young activists did not move. Soon, similar demonstrations ③spread to other public places across the region. These brave efforts eventually ④helped end racial segregation in the United States.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: ① Refuse → Refusing: '자리를 떠나기를 거부한 채'라는 분사구문은 Refusing(현재분사)으로 시작해야 함
det.analysis:
① Refuse — '① Refuse to leave their seats(자리를 떠나기를 거부한 채)'는 문장 앞에서 상황을 나타내는 분사구문이에요. 분사구문은 동사원형 Refuse가 아니라 Refusing(현재분사)으로 시작해야 해요 → Refusing ←정답

② told — 'staff repeatedly ② told them to go(직원이 그들에게 나가라고 말했다)' 과거시제, 적절해요.

③ spread — 'demonstrations ③ spread to other places(시위가 다른 곳으로 번졌다)'에서 spread는 과거형도 spread라 적절해요.

④ helped — 'efforts eventually ④ helped end segregation(노력이 분리를 끝내는 데 기여했다)' 과거시제, 적절해요.
det.tip: 문장 앞 분사구문 시작 = 현재분사(Refusing). 동사원형 Refuse 아님

questions.passage: The sit-in movement was part of the struggle for racial equality in the US. Its goal was to end the forced separation of races in public places. One of the most important events of this movement was the moment when some African American college students sat in a segregated section of a restaurant in North Carolina. They were told to leave, but they protested by remaining in their seats. This was not the first sit-in of the civil rights movement, but it led to a series of similar protests. During them, protesters occupied seats in places where races were segregated, including restaurants and libraries. They refused to move unless they were either served or arrested. Many establishments decided to end their practice of racial segregation rather than deal with more protests. These sit-ins helped pass the Civil Rights Act of 1964, which officially ended segregation in public places.

det.analysis: 본문 'they protested by remaining in their seats(그들은 자리에 남아 있음으로써 항의했다)'에서 학생들이 항의를 표현한 방식 = by remaining in their seats. 전치사 by(~함으로써) 뒤에 동명사 remaining이 왔어요.
det.tip: by + 동명사(-ing) = ~함으로써. by remaining(남아 있음으로써)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글 전체: 인종 분리에 맞선 연좌 농성이 번져 민권법으로 이어짐
det.analysis:
① 식당 산업 성장 — 식당은 배경일 뿐이에요.

③ 도서관 이용법 — 도서관은 시위 장소의 예일 뿐이에요.

④ 경제 성장 — 경제 이야기가 아니에요.
det.tip: 핵심 = 인종 분리·연좌 농성·민권법 → 분리에 맞선 운동과 성과

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 요지: 자리를 지킨 비폭력 저항이 인종 분리를 끝내는 민권법으로 이어짐
det.analysis:
① 법 없이 저절로 사라졌다 — 저항이 번지고 결국 민권법(법)이 분리를 끝냈으므로 '저절로'는 틀려요.

② 갈등을 키워 악화시켰다 — 시위는 분리 관행을 없애는 성과로 이어졌으므로 '악화'는 반대예요.

③ 자리를 지킨 비폭력 저항이 제도적 인종 차별을 끝내는 데 힘이 되었다 — 떠나라는 요구에도 자리를 지킨 평화적 저항이 번져 분리를 끝낸 민권법으로 이어졌다는 글의 핵심과 맞아요 ←정답

④ 법적 처벌 강화만이 — 핵심은 처벌 강화가 아니라 시민들의 비폭력 저항이에요.
det.tip: 떠나라는데도 자리 지킴(비폭력 저항) → 분리 종식. 이것이 요지
